name: SuperTuxKart 1.5
notes: Antarctica (STK's Irrlicht fork). In its Direct3D 9 mode (--render-driver=directx9) it runs through wined3d's Vulkan renderer, MoltenVK in the plain Wine tree; wined3d's default OpenGL renderer gets no pixel format on Macs without hardware OpenGL. Without d3dx9_43.dll it falls back to the fixed pipeline on Windows and on Wine alike ('Could not load shader function D3DXAssembleShader'). DXVK-macOS's d3d9 cannot make a device on the runner (MoltenVK lacks geometryShader and shaderCullDistance). Found by the game survey (docs/games.md).
